plain_english: If she — by her become self-nature — has never won final grounding, how could she become the standing-place of establishment for another existent?
sanskrit_cite: saivaṃ bhūtātmanā svenāpy alabdhapariniṣṭhitiḥ katham anyasya bhāvasya pratiṣṭhāspadatām iyāt

plain_english: Consciousness, apt to ground another thing's showing by saying 'this,' would take that grounding nature — and again, by itself, by saying 'I.'
sanskrit_cite: idam ity ucitaḥ saṃvit prakāśe 'nyasya vastunaḥ pratiṣṭhātmakatāṃ gacched aham ity ātmanā punaḥ

plain_english: For certainty — by exclusion and inclusion both — is called the fixed order, the foundation, the attainment, the completion of the other, inert selves.
sanskrit_cite: vyatireketarābhyām hi niścayo 'nyajaḍātmanoḥ vyavasthitiḥ pratiṣṭhā ca siddhir nirvṛttir ucyate

plain_english: So these inert ones, near-unreal in themselves, belong to shining alone; shining alone is — of its own self, through selves both own and other.
sanskrit_cite: evam ātmany asatkalpāḥ prakāśasyaiva santy amī jaḍāḥ prakāśa evāsti svātmanaḥ svaparātmabhiḥ

plain_english: And there is no experience apart from distinct-and-indistinct certainty — apart from connected shining, grasp-less in its self.
sanskrit_cite: na caivānubhavo 'py asti bhinnābhinnaviniścayam muktvānvayasya prakāśasya vimarśarahitātmanaḥ

plain_english: For this 'this'-grasping, cut off, fulfillment is rest in its own form — and that grasping, 'I am this,' is this itself.
sanskrit_cite: idam ity asya vicchinnavimarśasya kṛtārthatā yā svasvarūpe viśrāntir vimarśaḥ so 'ham ity ayam

plain_english: Twofold is this same self: measured and unmeasured — by breath and the rest restrained, an atom; as supreme self, unbroken.
sanskrit_cite: dvidhā sa eṣa evātmā mito 'parimitas tathā prāṇādinā niruddho 'ṇuḥ paramātmā tv akhaṇḍitaḥ

plain_english: For both, this is the end-ground of all object-awarenesses — one alone through continuity. So no other is possible.
sanskrit_cite: ubhayo 'py eṣa paryantabhūmiḥ sarvārthasaṃvidām eka evānusandhānād ato 'nyo nopapadyate

plain_english: And in the I-knowing whose self is non-separation grasp, limit-dwelling — nothing inert beyond shining appears.
sanskrit_cite: na cāpy avyatirekātmavimarśātmany ahaṃvidi bhāti paryantavartinyāṃ bhāsanād adhikaṃ jaḍam
